subject: Approval request — tenant isolation + KMS escrow for Helium Med pilot
messages:
From: Anya Volkov <anya.volkov@helium-med.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot requirements — KMS escrow + tenant isolation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our compliance team reviewed Redwood's private deployment options and surfaced two gating items for our initial pilot (single-customer production window):

- Tenant-level encryption with customer-managed KMS, and an escrow arrangement for key recovery for incident response only.
- Logical tenant isolation (no cross-tenant shared disks or network paths) and a strict egress block — we need a contract clause stating that no customer data will leave our VPC except to our whitelisted endpoints.

We'd like to lock in a 6-month pilot starting Nov 1 if we can get these guarantees plus a 20% pilot credit. Can you summarize what Redwood can commit to and what needs exec sign-off?

Attached: Helium_Med_KMS_Requirements_v1.pdf

Best,
Anya
Director, Cloud Compliance
Helium Med

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot requirements — KMS escrow + tenant isolation

Laura / Kim,

Looping you both — Helium wants a pilot but their compliance asks go beyond our standard Private T&Cs. Two asks look like deal-desk + exec sign-off: KMS escrow clauses and a hard egress prohibition + tenant isolation warranty. Marcus, FYI on infra implications.

Quick questions for deal desk:
- Is a KMS escrow clause materially risky (legal/regulatory)?
- Can we operationalize tenant isolation for a single namespace/pool without code changes?

I can push back on the 20% credit if needed, but need a clear list of items requiring approval.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Exec — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Helium_Med_KMS_Requirements_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot requirements — KMS escrow + tenant isolation

Thanks Priyom. I reviewed Helium's asks with Legal and Product:

- KMS escrow: Legal is cautious. We don't typically hold customer key material. An "escrow for emergency recovery" option is possible but requires a defined process (sealed escrow, dual control, narrow use cases, audit trail). Legal wants an SLA on activation and a one-time notarized request process.

- Tenant isolation / egress block: Product says we can provide dedicated tenant pools (single-tenant GPU pool) and apply strict network ACLs to prevent outbound to non-whitelisted endpoints. That will incur a fixed ops onboarding fee and slightly higher unit pricing.

- Pilot credit: Deal desk can grant up to 15% for a proof-of-concept; anything higher requires exec approval.

If we want this to proceed Nov 1, we need exec approval for:
1) Allowing a KMS-escrow arrangement with the requested activation policy.
2) One-time onboarding and the egress warranty clause (legal needs to sign off on liability language).
3) A pilot discount >15% (Helium requested 20%).

I can draft the contract language once we have exec alignment.

Laura
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Tenant_Isolation_Design_Summary.docx (docx)]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot requirements — KMS escrow + tenant isolation

Hi team — tagging Vivek for exec scope/approval. Short summary for exec:

1) Risk: Allowing an escrowed copy of KMS keys increases our operational burden and an attack surface. Legal proposes a sealed HSM escrow with dual custodian access and explicit forensic triggers. This is a rare exception but doable with controls.

2) Cost & timeline: Dedicated tenant pool + hardened egress ACLs = onboarding work: estimated 3 weeks infra-eng, $18k one-time onboarding, and a 12% increase to run-rate pricing for the pilot.

3) Discount ask: Helium asks 20% pilot credit. Deal desk can do 15% without exec sign-off; the extra 5% requires approval.

Ask for Vivek: If you sign off on the KMS-escrow with the legal process and approve up to a 20% pilot credit, we can lock Nov 1 start. If not, we propose a 15% credit + a 45-day audit window (read-only logs exported to Helium's S3) as a compromise.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot requirements — KMS escrow + tenant isolation

Thanks for the clear summary. I'm willing to approve the exception with the following non-negotiables: 

- KMS escrow only via sealed HSM escrow held by an approved third-party custodian; activation requires (a) written approval from Helium's CISO and (b) dual sign-off from Redwood legal + an SRE escalation lead.
- We will commit to a strict egress warranty limited to the pilot environment and documented whitelisted endpoints. Liability capped per the existing SOC/contract template; Legal to add a 90-day remediation hold before any broad escalation.
- Approve a one-time onboarding fee of $18,000 and a pilot credit of 18% (compromise between 15/20).

Operational steps: Marcus to own infra changes and provide a runbook; Kim to include the approved language in the MOA; Laura to confirm Legal will draft the escrow activation flow and indemnities. Priyom — please get Anya to sign the MOA and the DocuSign link once ready.

Vivek
VP Operations
Redwood Inference

- Pilot credit: 18% applied to the first 3 months.
